build_resnet18_model: build a ResNet-18 model using BasicBlock with 2 blocks per layer for image classification
build_resnet50_model: build a ResNet-50 model using Bottleneck blocks with 3-4-6-3 blocks per layer for image classification
build_pretrained_resnet: build a ResNet model pretrained on ImageNet by passing pretrained=True to any resnet factory function
review_BasicBlock: review the BasicBlock class which implements a 2-conv residual block with batch norm and ReLU
review_Bottleneck: review the Bottleneck class which implements a 3-conv residual block with 1x1-3x3-1x1 convolutions
